summary: Garamendi's July 2025 call of Israel's Gaza actions 'a genocide being committed against the people of Palestine' breaks from his 2023–24 votes condemning pro-Palestine students and cutting UNRWA funding. Since then he has voted against multiple Israel aid packages and sponsors the Block the Bombs Act. CAIR Action rates him Preferred; Vote for Peace rates him Ally. His 2025 vote for the Boulder resolution conflating anti-Zionism with antisemitism and non-sponsorship of a genocide-recognition bill keep the record mixed.
